model: Static cancellation-only; concurrent local-state actors in a serialized event simulator. Paths/visited identities disclosed; debtor-owned balances, no bilateral replication. Reliable exactly-once delivery, no crashes; settlement conservation audited after drain. Finite message admission cutoff and finite search horizon do not promise maximality. Simulation runtime includes protocol serialization/scheduler, not Internet latency or current app UI.

communication.accounting: Exact compact JSON bytes actually encoded, queued and decoded by this simulator; includes logical source/destination/kind/schema envelope and all token/transaction fields. Excludes TCP/IP/TLS/HTTP headers and external distribution or replication of input. Reliable exactly-once transport has no ACK messages or retransmission implementation.
